data.name: Abigail
data.gender_notes: Abigail is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Avigayil: avi, 'my father', + gil, 'joy'. Its root is Hebrew ʾ-b-y-g-y-l. Abigail, wife of David (1 Samuel 25). Abigail is a Hebrew name meaning “My father is joy”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Abigail expresses “My father is joy”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Hebrew Avigayil: avi, 'my father', + gil, 'joy'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abigail total 32, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
